name: netsim
description: NetSim — browser-based network simulator with a Cisco IOS-style CLI, packet capture (.pcap), and an on-device AI tutor. A zero-install, open-source CCNA lab. Live demo + FastAPI.

paragraphs: Practice CCNA-level networking in your browser. No installs, no VMs, no license. Build a topology, configure routers and switches with real Cisco IOS-style commands, capture packets to Wireshark .pcap, and ask a built-in AI tutor why your lab isn't working.
🚀 Try the live demo · Features · Quickstart · Automation · Architecture · AI tutor pipeline · Why NetSim?

NetSim is an open-source, browser-based network simulator (a lightweight, web-native alternative to Cisco Packet Tracer / GNS3) for learning and teaching networking. The protocol behaviour — switching, routing, ARP, ICMP, DHCP, spanning tree — is modelled in pure Python, so the whole simulator runs as an ordinary web app with zero installation: open a URL and start configuring a router.
features: Zero install, browser-native. Packet Tracer needs a NetAcad account and a desktop install; GNS3/EVE-NG need heavy VMs and licensed IOS images. NetSim is a single URL — ideal for students, interviews, and quick "what…

An integrated AI tutor. Most free simulators have no teaching layer. NetSim runs a fine-tuned LLM in the browser that explains why a lab is broken, grounded by a deterministic rules engine so the facts stay correct.
Labs-as-code + auto-grading. Declarative topologies and grading checks make it a self-study and assessment tool, not just a sandbox.
